description: An extraction task (extraction/Example2026/) with two submitted inputs, an adjudication and its approval. contentHash is the hash the approval is bound to, computed by tools/mundlib/extraction.py; the browser (admin/js/extraction.js) must compute the same. pdf is the base64 of the stand-in PDF whose SHA-256 the task records. Written by hand (with tools/mundlib/extraction.py for the hash).
